name: Lewes
meta_description: Lewes and Harvey's brewery: Sussex Best by the Ouse, historic town pubs and Brighton's beer scene — with bookable tastings 15 minutes away.
intro_md:
Lewes is a brewery town in the fullest sense. Harvey's has brewed beside the Ouse since 1790, and its Victorian Gothic brewhouse — affectionately known as Lewes Cathedral — still perfumes the town centre on brewing days. Sussex Best Bitter is the local currency, poured with care in pubs across the county.

The town drinks well beyond the brewery gates. The John Harvey Tavern sits opposite the brewery yard, the Lewes Arms tucks in behind the castle with its own gently eccentric traditions, and the Snowdrop Inn at the foot of Cliffe is a favourite for cask ale and food.

Brighton is fifteen minutes away by train, bringing micropubs, taprooms and tasting experiences within easy reach — which is why the bookable experiences below are Brighton-based.

**Don't miss**

- The Harvey's brewery shop on Cliffe High Street
- A pint of Sussex Best at the John Harvey Tavern
- Bonfire Night, if you can time your visit for it

gyg_tours.title: Brighton: Local Beer Tasting Experience at a Micropub
gyg_tours.summary: A one-hour guided tasting at BeerBelly micropub in Hove, sampling a selection of local beers and craft brews from UK breweries with the pub's owner.
gyg_tours.description_md: Head to BeerBelly, an independent micropub and bottle shop in Brighton and Hove, just a short walk from the seafront. Meet Robin, the owner and beer enthusiast, for a tasting of a selection of local beers and craft brews from breweries across the UK. As you sip each one, you'll learn about the different flavours and styles and get to know the local beer scene. The experience finishes with the BeerBelly shot of the week.
highlights: Taste local beers and UK craft brews
Tasting led by owner and beer enthusiast Robin
Visit a family-owned micropub and bottle shop
Learn about different beer flavours and styles
Finish with the BeerBelly shot of the week
gyg_tours.meeting_point: BeerBelly micropub, Brighton and Hove, near the seafront

gyg_tours.title: Brighton Bar Crawl: 5+ Venues, Free Shots, Free Club Entry
gyg_tours.summary: A five-hour guided crawl of at least five bars and clubs in central Brighton, with free shots, discounted drink deals and free entry to the final club included.
gyg_tours.description_md: Join a guided evening bar crawl through Brighton's city centre, visiting at least five bars and clubs with energetic hosts leading the way. The experience is built around meeting new people and exploring the local nightlife, with a free shot at every bar and reduced drink prices via a wristband. The night finishes with free club entry.
highlights: Visit at least 5 bars and clubs
Free club entry at the end
gyg_tours.meeting_point: Fitz Regent, 7-8 Castle Square, Brighton and Hove, Brighton BN1 1EG (meet 19:30)

gyg_tours.title: Brighton: Beer Bike Ride with Drinks and Music
gyg_tours.summary: A one-hour pedal-powered bar ride through Brighton with drinks and music on board and a sober driver steering; priced per group of up to eight passengers.
gyg_tours.description_md: Gather a group of friends and climb aboard a pedal-powered beer bike for a 60-minute ride through Brighton, while a trained sober driver takes care of the steering so everyone can relax. The bike carries up to 15 guests and comes with cold drinks and a Bluetooth music system for your own soundtrack. It's a sociable way to see the seaside city while enjoying a drink together.
highlights: 4 beers or half a bottle of prosecco per guest
gyg_tours.meeting_point: Brighton (start coordinates 50.823625, -0.1504169); exact street address not stated on the page
